beats.b01: Hi, I'm Juno. Here's AIA Voice Insights, in two minutes.
beats.b02: The conversation is the easy part. Then come notes, fact-finds and follow-ups, typed from memory, late and uneven. Risks surface weeks later.
beats.b03: Capture it your way: dictate after the meeting, listen live, or let me debrief you, in English, Mandarin, Malay or Tamil. No re-typing, and every customer served in their language.
beats.b04: In a debrief, I say what I understood and ask up to five short questions about gaps. A live meter tracks twenty-six fact-find fields, and risky promises are flagged.
beats.b05: With the customer, I follow needs, mood and buying signals, suggest the next best question, and flag risky statements as they're said.
beats.b06: Eleven specialist agents then analyse the case in thirty to forty seconds, grounded in product documents. Only a person can start the analysis, and every result is a suggestion.
beats.b07: The advice pack is drafted for you: fact-find, record of advice, follow-up, CRM note and report. You edit and sign off. Nothing is sent without you.
beats.b08: Ask me why a product was picked, or what if there's one more child. The sums are done by code, not by the AI, and the working is shown.
beats.b09: Say Hey Juno to go hands-free: open screens, press buttons, hear a briefing or the full report, and say stop any time.
beats.b10: Before the next meeting, rehearse. I play your customer from your own debrief, then coach what landed and what you missed.
beats.b11: It's built for trust: ID and card numbers are never stored, weak speech is filtered out, and Juno suggests while you decide.
beats.b12: The impact: advisors get time back to sell, customers get faster follow-up, compliance is caught early, and leaders see one view across the agency force.
beats.b13: Premiums are up thirty-six percent, yet seventy-four percent of critical illness cover is missing. Six hours back per rep is about seventy-four thousand hours a month, an illustration.
beats.b14: Let's prove it together. Just say, Hey Juno.
